question: What benefits does the Rāma yantra confer without any doubt?
premises: The diagram is identified as the Rāma yantra.
It is said to give fame, prosperity, and victory.
The text asserts there is no doubt about this.
inference: The Rāma yantra undoubtedly grants fame, prosperity, and victory.
plain_english: The Rāma yantra gives fame, prosperity, and victory—there is no doubt.
